answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 1783 Country: Canada Title: Is kangaroo meat Halal? Question: Assalaam Alaikum Is kangaroo meat Halal? Answer ID: 1783 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1306/1175=B) The meat of kangaroo is haram ; this is an uneatable animal, its meat is not halal . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
